stories.headline: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Following Espionage Scandal
stories.summary: Nvidia's board has unanimously voted to reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang as chief executive, less than two weeks after his resignation. Huang had stepped down amid an alleged spy scandal involving a woman suspected of intelligence ties to China. His return followed discussions involving US government officials, including President Donald Trump, though the decision drew bipartisan criticism from US lawmakers.
